'''''Lythrum junceum''''' is a species of perennial herb in the family [[Lythraceae]] native to the [[Mediterranean Basin]], [[West Asia]] and [[Macaronesia]].<ref>{{cite web |title=Lythrum junceum Banks & Sol.; Russell, Nat. Hist. Aleppo ed. 2, 2: 253 (1794) |url=https://www.worldplants.de/world-plants-complete-list/complete-plant-list/?name=Lythrum-junceum#plantUid-214301 |website=www.worldplants.de |publisher=World Plants: Complete Plant List |access-date=20 March 2022}}</ref> They have a self-supporting growth form and simple, broad leaves. They are associated with freshwater habitat. Individuals can grow to 0.2 m.<ref>{{Cite web|title=Lythrum junceum Banks \u0026 Solander - Encyclopedia of Life|url=https://eol.org/pages/5429394|access-date=2022-02-04|website=eol.org}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |last=Mifsud |first=Stephen |date=2002-08-23 |title=Lythrum junceum (Creeping Loosestrife): MaltaWildPlants.com - the online Flora of the Maltese Islands. |url=https://www.maltawildplants.com/LYTH/Lythrum_junceum.php |access-date=2022-03-05 |website=www.maltawildplants.com |language=en-us}}</ref>
